reviews.title: Great mic!
reviews.comment: Great repayment mic for church sound system will be ordering again for sure
reviews.author: Wade posey

reviews.title: Works!
reviews.comment: Works great, easy to hookup to shure machine. Loud and sensitive microphone. Hard to get the plug out of the wireless mic receiver. Like the clip.
reviews.author: Lily

reviews.title: Not quite right.
reviews.comment: Agree with other reviewers who indicated that this mic, compared to OEM, is much hotter and sensitive, leading to feedback issues. Also, as others have stated, found disconnecting the mic quite difficult.
reviews.author: M. Harris

reviews.title: Easy to Attach
reviews.comment: I had ear piece mic that drove me crazy. I wear hearing aids.  This attached easily to lapel.
reviews.author: Randy W Ledbetter

reviews.title: Very poor quality.
reviews.comment: I bought this 9 months ago to have a spare.  Got it out maybe a month or two ago and started to use it.  Already experiencing complaints on audio in our internet live feed as well as in person.  I have ordered a name brand replacement.
reviews.author: Wes
